stem_book: A stone projected with a velocity a at an angle θ with the horizontal reaches maximum height H₁. When it is projected with velocity a at an angle (π/2 − θ) with the horizontal, it reaches a maximum height H₂. The relation between the horizontal range R of the projectile, H₁ and H₂ is: (a) R = 4√(H₁H₂) (b) R = 4(H₁ − H₂) (c) R = 4(H₁ + H₂) (d) R = H₁²/H₂
